data.body:
[P2] Validate supplied optional fields independently of the scenario

Adding `replay: null` to otherwise-valid normal-return evidence, or setting `profile.recoveryPolicy` to `false`, passes both validation phases because only replay/recovery scenarios inspect those fields. The published v1 schema rejects both documents, but the offline CLI uses this validator and can report them as `PASSED`. Add structural validation for supplied, recognized optional fields before interpreting scenario behavior, preserving support for unknown extension fields, and add schema/validator parity tests for these cases.
